gene_expression_viewer.embedding_method: scanpy 1.10.3: read_10x_mtx of GSM7466900's deposited Cell Ranger output (499 raw cells, 33538 genes), QC (min 200 genes/cell, <20% pct_counts_mt; 499->451 cells), filter_genes min_cells=3 (16498 genes), normalize_total+log1p, top-2000 HVG, PCA, neighbors, UMAP, Leiden (resolution 0.5, 6 clusters, igraph flavor). Gene panel: 11 guaranteed meningioma driver genes + top HVGs by dispersion to 150 total. Cluster identity via rank_genes_groups (Wilcoxon) matched against canonical marker sets; pathway scores via score_genes.
